milestones.title: Phase 0: Foundations
milestones.description: GitHub repo hygiene, ADR review, Dropbox/git safety, brand graphic. See docs/ROADMAP.md.

milestones.title: Phase 1: First feed end to end
milestones.description: NOAA SWPC solar wind: poll -> raw landing zone -> TimescaleDB -> Grafana, with CI and an About page.

milestones.title: Phase 2: Space weather + satellites
milestones.description: GOES X-rays, Kp, alerts; CelesTrak satellite history with altitude; FastAPI read endpoints.

milestones.title: Phase 3: Public website
milestones.description: Design survey and brief, React + Plotly frontend, responsive tests, About links, science page, first AI agent.

milestones.title: Phase 4: Deploy to the cloud
milestones.description: Choose provider (ADR 0011 criteria), infrastructure as code, deploy pipeline, text-to-SQL agent.

milestones.title: Phase 5: Value-add science
milestones.description: Drag Watch, Rust benchmark, Sun-as-a-star, power-grid explainer, stretch agents, MLflow.

issues.title: Protect main and enable secret scanning
issues.body:
## Why
The repo exists (private). `main` should only change through PRs that pass CI, and leaked secrets should be blocked on push.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Branch protection (or a ruleset) on `main`: require PR, require status checks once CI exists
- [ ] Secret scanning + push protection enabled (check availability for private repos on your plan)
- [ ] Note what you enabled in docs/github-workflow.md

## Related docs / ADRs
- [ADR 0010](https://github.com/howardisaacson/tachocline-industries/blob/main/docs/decisions/0010-use-git-and-github-from-day-one.md)
- [docs/github-workflow.md](https://github.com/howardisaacson/tachocline-industries/blob/main/docs/github-workflow.md)

## What you'll learn
Branch protection vs rulesets, secret scanning, why solo devs still use PRs.

issues.title: Make the Dropbox + git setup safe
issues.body:
## Why
The working copy lives in Dropbox, which can corrupt `.git/` and wastes sync on heavy folders.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Decide: keep in Dropbox (one machine, ignored folders) or move the clone to ~/code
- [ ] Mark node_modules/.venv/data as Dropbox-ignored if staying
- [ ] Docker DB data uses named volumes, not Dropbox paths

## Related docs / ADRs
- [AGENTS.md §9](https://github.com/howardisaacson/tachocline-industries/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [ADR 0010](https://github.com/howardisaacson/tachocline-industries/blob/main/docs/decisions/0010-use-git-and-github-from-day-one.md)

## What you'll learn
How file sync differs from version control.

issues.title: SWPC poller: fetch rtsw_wind_1m + rtsw_mag_1m into the raw landing zone
issues.milestone: Phase 1: First feed end to end
issues.body:
## Why
SWPC only serves ~24 h, so we must fetch on a schedule and keep our own history.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] APScheduler job every 5 min with timeout + User-Agent
- [ ] Raw response saved to data/raw/swpc_rtsw/<date>/
- [ ] Stops and logs on 4xx; unit tests with mocked HTTP

## Related docs / ADRs
- [ADR 0003](https://github.com/howardisaacson/tachocline-industries/blob/main/docs/decisions/0003-first-data-source-noaa-swpc-real-time-solar-wind.md)
- [ADR 0004](https://github.com/howardisaacson/tachocline-industries/blob/main/docs/decisions/0004-python-scheduled-pollers-with-raw-landing-zone.md)

## What you'll learn

issues.title: Validate with pydantic and upsert into TimescaleDB
issues.milestone: Phase 1: First feed end to end
issues.body:
## Why
Validation catches upstream schema changes; upserts make reruns safe.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] pydantic models for wind and mag rows; rejects counted
- [ ] INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE on (time_tag, source)
- [ ] ingest_log row per run; tests prove a rerun adds no duplicates

## Related docs / ADRs
